scripts.build: vite build && pwsh -Command "Remove-Item static/tools/place-helper.html -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Move-Item static/dist/src/tools/place-helper/place-helper.html static/tools/place-helper.html; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force static/assets -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Move-Item static/dist/assets static/assets; Copy-Item static/dist/js/adventure-map.bundle.js static/js/adventure-map.bundle.js; $css = Get-ChildItem static/assets/adventure-map-*.css | Select-Object -First 1; if ($css) { Copy-Item $css.FullName static/css/adventure-map.bundle.css }; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force static/dist -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
